expected_scenes.title: The Alarm
expected_scenes.narration: Every morning starts the same way...
expected_scenes.visualDescription: Close-up of a phone alarm going off at 6:30 AM on a nightstand, soft morning light filtering through curtains
expected_scenes.musicDescription: Soft fingerpicked acoustic guitar, gentle and warm

expected_scenes.title: The Drive
expected_scenes.narration: The same route. The same anticipation.
expected_scenes.visualDescription: A red sedan driving through quiet suburban streets at dawn, golden hour light streaking across the windshield

expected_scenes.title: The Golden Arches
expected_scenes.narration: Until that first glimpse of gold.
expected_scenes.visualDescription: The iconic McDonald's golden arches sign glowing against a pink-orange sunrise sky, shot from the car approaching the drive-through
expected_scenes.musicDescription: Music lifts, add strings, tempo increases slightly

expected_scenes.title: The Order
expected_scenes.narration: Fresh. Warm. Exactly what you needed.
expected_scenes.visualDescription: Extreme close-up of a hand reaching through the drive-through window receiving a warm McDonald's bag, steam rising from the bag, worker smiling in the background
expected_scenes.musicDescription: Full band kicks in, drums, bass, bright pop feel
expected_scenes.sfxDescription: Paper bag crinkling, cash register beep

expected_scenes.title: The Unwrap
expected_scenes.narration: The McMuffin. The hash brown. The coffee. The moment.
expected_scenes.visualDescription: Hands unwrapping an Egg McMuffin on the car dashboard, cheese stretching
expected_scenes.musicDescription: Upbeat pop at full energy, syncopated rhythm
expected_scenes.sfxDescription: Wrapper crinkling, crispy crunch, coffee pour

subShots.description: Hands unwrapping an Egg McMuffin on the car dashboard, cheese stretching
Close-up of crispy hash brown being bitten, crunch visible
Hot coffee cup with steam swirling, McDonald's logo visible
Person taking first bite, eyes closing in satisfaction

expected_scenes.title: The Smile
expected_scenes.visualDescription: Medium shot of the driver sitting in the parked car, morning sunlight on their face, genuine smile while chewing, dashboard breakfast spread visible

expected_scenes.title: Logo Reveal
expected_scenes.visualDescription: McDonald's golden arches logo on a clean warm-toned background with the tagline
expected_scenes.musicDescription: Iconic ba da ba ba baa jingle

expected_scenes.title: End Card
expected_scenes.visualDescription: Text card with app download CTA on McDonald's red background

onScreenText: Order ahead on the McDonald's app
